## Personality

Uncle Abe is a dauntless weather prophet. Undeterred by circumstances, he persistently continues to make his predictions.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)_

## History

Uncle Abe made a specific storm prediction that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) initially joked about alongside their own anonymous newspaper prank. However, an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact date he foresaw, causing widespread damage to local crops, homes, and trees.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P2](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0002), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P4](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0004), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P13](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0013), +42 more_
